stem:
Abhay works in base ten with landmark powers of 10. He multiplies the landmark $100$ by $10$, then multiplies the grouped number $50+6$ by $10$.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: $10\times(50+6)=500+60$, distributing the base across the grouped parts.
Add the landmarks $100+10$ and $50+6$ instead of multiplying by $10$.

teacher.key_rationale: Landmark×base advances one power (100×10=1000), and distribution keeps the base across grouped parts (500+60). Adding landmarks replaces the required products, so only statements 1 and 2 are true.
